_doc: Bannerline input bindings, one table per device TYPE. Actions are the vocabulary js/input/commands.js understands. Keyboard codes are KeyboardEvent.code; mouse buttons are Mouse0 (left), Mouse1 (middle), Mouse2 (right); WheelUp/WheelDown. Gamepad names are the standard-mapping button names in js/input/gamepad.js (M2). Per-device overrides are saved in localStorage (shared/store.js, namespace bannerline) and merged over these.

gamepad._doc: Left stick moves (moveDir), right stick aims (centred = auto-target). A attacks the nearest enemy. LB + d-pad = deck sends; LB + d-pad HELD half a second = toggle that send's auto. D-pad alone: left/right drink (belt), up = Muster, down = buy a potion. LT + a skill button learns a rank. View opens the Armory panel with the best upgrade focused (two presses: View, A). Menu = pause. Menus: d-pad or left stick moves, A confirms, B goes back. navUp/navDown/navLeft/navRight are synthesised from the d-pad and the stick by js/input/gamepad.js.
